ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark grey pixels with localized high-intensity white clusters; estimated white-to-dark ratio is approximately 0.08.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark base pigmentation with discrete high-contrast white circular blobs distributed across both lobes; thin linear white discontinuities observed primarily on the left lobe and central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 45 degrees; the vertex is partially occluded by water spray reflection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged serrations (1-5 pixel peaks) along the entire visible superior boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature observed on the outer lateral margins of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of circular white high-contrast clusters across the visible surface, with higher density on the right lobe medial section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct white linear pixel disruptions; most prominent is a vertical-diagonal scratch on the left lobe and intersecting marks near the median notch area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring including both circular rosette clusters and unaligned linear abrasions distributed across the entire visible surface area.
other_distinctive_markers: Specular glare and water spray occlude the lower central boundary where the fluke meets the waterline.
